# BIZEASE SOLUTIONS

> BIZEASE SOLUTIONS is a business consultancy in Islamabad, Pakistan (since 2016). Tax consultancy, NTN and FBR filing, SECP company registration, accounting and bookkeeping, audit, ERP and IT services, digital marketing and international company formation (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UK, USA). Tagline: All business needs under one roof.

Contact: +92 308 4535456 | info@bizeasesolutions.online | Islamabad, Pakistan. Hours: Mon to Sat, 10am to 6pm PKT.
